## About
Jerry Gowens Garage is a family owned and operated shop in the Historic Downtown of Fairburn, just south of Atlanta. We want to be your hometown auto repair center, where you are a person to us, not just a number.
As a Napa Auto Care Service Center, we use quality aftermarket parts, and we honor and accept manufacturer warranties. We use factory scan tools on both foreign and domestic vehicles, so we can work on just about whatever you drive in.
Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating from 85 reviews on Google. If you stop by, you might meet Roscoe the shop dog. One reviewer said they fell in love with him.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics: Finding out what is going on under the hood before we fix it.
- Jasper engine work: We are Jasper engine specialists.
- Jasper transmission work: We are Jasper transmission specialists.
- Brakes and rotors: Brake and rotor replacement.
- Oil and lube with tire rotation: Routine oil service with a tire rotation included.
- Emission repair: Repairs to get your vehicle's emissions back where they should be.
- Electrical repairs: Tracking down and fixing electrical problems.
- Factory recommended maintenance: The maintenance your vehicle's manufacturer recommends.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We repair all makes and all models of vehicles.

Q: Do you honor manufacturer warranties?
A: Yes. We honor and accept all manufacturer warranties.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Call us at (770) 964-8526 to set up an appointment.
